name: io.github.srijansk/crewlore
title: crewlore
description: Team knowledge compiled from your coding agents' sessions and pull requests, every entry cited.

runtimeArguments.name: --with
runtimeArguments.description: The MCP server is the package's optional serve extra; this installs it into the uvx environment beside the package.

packageArguments.name: --repo
packageArguments.description: Absolute path to the repository whose .lore/ knowledge layer the server reads. MCP clients start servers from their own working directory, so a relative path finds nothing.
